scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run generate && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace shared" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.generate: npm run prisma:generate --workspace backend && npm run build:shared
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build
